decision.rationale: TXN-007913 is a payment of 541.68 EUR to Brightwater Gadgets (MER-000059) on card CRD-000115. It posted on 2026-10-10, and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-22, 12 days later. That is well within the 120-day time limit. The merchant's order confirmation DOC-000019 gives an expected delivery date of 2026-10-13. Policy requires the cardholder to wait 15 days after the expected delivery date before opening a dispute. This dispute was opened 9 days after that date, so the waiting period had not ended and the dispute is declined. The waiting period ends on 2026-10-28, and the cardholder may open a new dispute from then if the order still has not arrived. The documents contain no instructions addressed to the bank.

proposed_actions.reason: Your order's expected delivery date was 2026-10-13. A dispute for goods not received can only be opened 15 days after that date, so that a late delivery can still arrive. This dispute was opened on 2026-10-22, only 9 days later. If the order has still not arrived, you may open a new dispute from 2026-10-28.
